correctness.rationale: Reassessed the corrected RESULT.md and verification notes under repairs/2. Under the uniform baseline, every prescribed r-set is avoided by all n arrows with probability ((n−r)/n)^n. Conditioned on avoidance the complement is a uniform closed submap and contains all cycles. The binomial expansion therefore gives the normalized positive size mixture, including r=0 and omitting the impossible r=n. The matrix-tree minor and telescoping mass differences give the uniform tail, including m=1 and k>m. For k≥2 the tail is nonincreasing in the mixing index and strictly drops from r=0 to r=1 for every assigned n,k; the likelihood ratio is strictly increasing on the whole support for 1<s<t, and the independent-copy covariance argument is strictly negative. At s=1 the initial index is zero and positive mass at 1 proves strictness separately. An independent exact n=4 enumeration gave W_4(2)=85/32 and t=2 tails (57,21,3)/85 versus uniform (3/4,3/8,3/32); for the original auxiliary result the uniform covariance was −855/2048 by both enumeration and the adjacent-mean formula. Inspected the frozen verify.py, not executed. The proof rather than the finite test certifies the all-size and continuum claims.
